| `fields` | `query` | `Array<string>` | No | No | Requested fields. If `fields` is not set, only the default fields will be returned. Default value: `["item_id","caption"]`. If you specify this field, only the mentioned posts published by TikTok users registered in the specified regions will be returned.If this field is not specified, all mentioned posts will be returned. | `cursor` | `query` | `number` | No | No | Cursor for pagination. The position of the results that you want to retrieve from. For instance, setting `cursor` to 10 means you want to retrieve the next page of results after the 10th position. If the response parameter `has_more` is `true`, pass the returned cursor in this parameter in the subsequent request to receive the next page of results. Default value: 0. |
| `max_count` | `query` | `number` | No | No | The maximum number of comments to be returned for each page of data. Default value: 100. Value range: 1-100. Note: Due to our trust and safety policies, it is possible that the endpoint returns less than the `max_count` number of comments even if the response parameter `has_more` is `true`. |
